subject: Request: Live BCP Witness & RTO Evidence for Phase 2 Onboarding
messages:
From: Helen Park <hpark@evergreenbank.com>
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@evergreenbank.com>, Tim Sato <tim.sato@custco.io>
Date: Thu, 18 Dec 2025 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Request: Live BCP Witness & RTO Evidence for Phase 2 Onboarding

Hi Karthik,

Thanks again for the walkthrough yesterday. As part of Evergreen Bank's Phase 2 security onboarding (SIG + SOC2 cross-check), Procurement and our Resilience team need a short live witness session and a bundle of RTO/RPO evidence ahead of our internal acceptance meeting. Specifically we need: 

- A 30–45 minute live witness (ops-led) showing failover activation and warm-cache resume; attendees will include our resilience SME and a procurement rep.
- RTO attestation for multi-region failover (target: 15 minutes) and a short sample of KV cache warm-up timings.
- Keystore rotation and custody list, plus signed acknowledgement of retention policy.
- An indexed PDF of the runbook you’ll use during the demo.

Could you confirm availability for a witness on either Mon 12/21 15:00 PST or Tue 12/22 10:00 PST? Also please send the runbook and any pre-read artifacts we should circulate to our SMEs.

I’ve attached our internal BCP intake worksheet (EG-BusinessContinuity_Questionnaire.xlsx) for reference.

Appreciate the quick turnaround—this is on the critical path for our Phase 2 cutover.

Best,
Helen
Helen Park
Senior Resilience Manager
Evergreen Bank
Attachments: EG-BusinessContinuity_Questionnaire.xlsx
From: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
To: Helen Park <hpark@evergreenbank.com>
Cc: priyom_das@redwood.ai, Procurement Team <procurement@evergreenbank.com>
Date: Thu, 18 Dec 2025 11:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: Live BCP Witness & RTO Evidence for Phase 2 Onboarding

Hi Helen — thanks for the clear list. We can do this and will prepare the artifacts you requested. Quick responses to your asks: 

- Live witness windows: Mon 12/21 15:00 PST works for Redwood Ops; we can also do Tue 12/22 10:00 PST if you prefer.
- RTO attestation: our documented target for the multi-region warm failover path is 15 minutes under normal load; we'll bring timing samples from recent rehearsals.
- KV cache warm-up: we'll publish a short CSV with sample warm-cache timing slices (per-region).
- Keystore custody and rotation: we'll include the custodian manifest and our key rotation cadence.

I’m attaching the runbook we'll use as the pre-read (runbook_v2.pdf). For the live witness, I’ll loop in Priyom (solutions) and Ben (ops lead) to coordinate the actual demo steps and to provide the KV snapshot export.

Proposed next step: confirm preferred window and we'll send a calendar invite + an ops pre-call 30m before the witness to run through roles.

Thanks,

--
Karthik Iyer
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Ben / Karthik — forwarding Helen's ask. Ops checklist I'm proposing for the witness:

1) Provide kv_snapshot_20251217.csv for the region pair (us-west/us-east) — includes sequential sample of prefix loads and resume timings.
2) Produce a short RTO timing table (15m target) with timestamps from our last rehearsal.
3) Keystore custody list + last rotation record (redacted key ids ok).
4) Create a witness-invite.ics and a 30m ops pre-call slot.
5) Prepare the live failover run: sequence, verification queries, and rollback path.

I'll generate the KV snapshot and the timing table now and attach to the thread (kv_snapshot_20251217.csv). Ben — can you confirm ops availability for Mon 12/21 15:00 PST?

Thanks,
